name: worldtree wood
lore_descriptor: wood from the axis of the world; grain that runs through it like rivers
unidentified_descriptor: a wood the eye cannot quite focus on
first_pickup_chronicle: Worldtree wood. Yggdrasil. Ashvattha. The Tree of Knowledge. Pick the myth you like — the wood is the same. So is the price of cutting it.
design_notes: F92 peak — wood equivalent of orichalcum/sunsteel. damage_mult 1.45, divine-tier. Triple-elemental resist, anti-undead/demon. Spreads narrow (8) — this is endgame material.
